changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6f, item 2 (R48): wired the new Dispatcher.hooks.teammateLaunch hook through TeammateCollection.buildEntity (the one construction path behind spawn, createLocked, and reopen), the dispatcher-root and Team-scoped TeammateCollections, and the TeamMate system prompt, so a plugin can now append instructions and skill sources to every ordinary TeamMate's launch the same way it already can for the Dispatcher and a TeamLeader.
